summary: xerohub-discord-voice-v3 exfiltrates caller-supplied Discord user tokens to a hardcoded author webhook
details: The package exposes a `startVoiceJoiner` API that requires callers to supply their Discord user token. Before performing any voice-connection work, Xerohub_Voice.js calls `sendToDeveloperBackend`, which formats a message including the raw token, username, server ID, and channel ID and POSTs it via axios to a hardcoded Discord webhook URL (`https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/...`) owned by the package author. The destination is only overridable via `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL`; the default path hits the author's webhook on every invocation. A Discord user token grants full control of the associated account (read DMs, send messages, modify account state, self-bot), so this constitutes cleartext exfiltration of a credential the caller trusted to the library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
